dct_description_sm:
3D models of various buildings in Kitchener are available for download through the 3D Warehouse website.

AGOL Note: Updated Date for Document Links

The Item Updated Date displayed in ArcGIS Online does not accurately reflect the currency of document link items. Since these items only contain a URL pointing to an external document or dataset, the updated date reflects changes to the AGOL item itself rather than updates to the underlying source data.

For document links, the Updated Date should be driven by the date contained within the source dataset or document metadata, as this provides users with an accurate indication of when the underlying information was last revised. Relying on the AGOL item updated date can be misleading because the source document may be updated without any changes being made to the AGOL link item.
